name: Ebihara Minase
source: Minase is Jun’s kouhai who plays the trumpet in the brass band. She’s an energetic girl who is also very competitive. Jun nicknames her Ebi (which she doesn’t like at first because he's calling her "Shrimp"). She seems to wander the streets at night…
